method.description: Selected functions paired across builds using semantic strings/xrefs, callees/callers, decompiled behavior and, for listed cases, SequenceMatcher similarity over instruction mnemonic sequences.
limitations: Operands, code addresses, data references and full CFG topology are not encoded in the reported ratio.
A high similarity supports but does not prove behavioral identity.
A low similarity can indicate a rewrite or a sequence-shape change and requires semantic inspection.
Missing literals do not prove absent dynamically formatted or virtual-call behavior.
